@Public @Stable public abstract class ValueAggregatorJobBase<K1 extends WritableComparable,V1 extends Writable> extends Object implements Mapper<K1,V1,Text,Text>, Reducer<Text,Text,Text,Text>
This abstract class implements some common functionalities of the the generic mapper, reducer and combiner classes of Aggregate.
